title: Open Data Product Standard (ODPS)
description: An open data product standard descriptor to enable defining data products.

apiVersion.description: Version of the standard used to build data product. Default value is v1.1.0.

kind.description: The kind of file this is. Valid value is `DataProduct`.

id.description: A unique identifier used to reduce the risk of dataset name collisions, such as a UUID.

deprecated.description: Indicates this data product is deprecated and should not be used in new implementations. Defaults to false.

version.description: Current version of the data product. Not required, but highly recommended.

status.description: Current status of the data product.

type.description: Architectural type of the data product. Common values: `sourceAligned`, `aggregate`, `consumerAligned`. Organizations may define custom types.

authoritativeDefinitions.description: List of links to sources that provide more details on the data contract.

customProperties.description: A list of key/value pairs for custom properties.

inputPorts.description: List of objects describing an input port. You need at least one as a data product needs to get data somewhere.

outputPorts.description: List of objects describing an output port. You need at least one, as a data product without output is useless.

managementPorts.description: Management ports define access points for managing the data product.

productCreatedTs.description: Timestamp in UTC of when the data product was created, using ISO 8601.

Tags.description: A list of tags that may be assigned to the elements (object or property); the tags keyword may appear at any level. Tags may be used to better categorize an element. For example, `finance`, `sensitive`, `employee_record`.

purpose.description: Intended purpose for the provided data.

limitations.description: Technical, compliance, and legal limitations for data use.

authoritativeDefinitions.description: List of links to sources that provide more details on the data contract.

customProperties.description: A list of key/value pairs for custom properties.

CustomProperty.description: A key/value pair for custom properties.

id.description: A unique identifier for the element used to create stable, refactor-safe references. Recommended for elements that will be referenced.

property.description: The name of the key. Names should be in camel case, the same as if they were permanent properties in the contract.

vendor.description: Identifies the vendor, provider, or external system associated with this custom property. SHOULD be a stable, lowercase identifier matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$ (e.g. confluent, zeenea, atlan, soda). Tools MUST preserve unknown vendor values.

Synonyms.description: A list of alternative names for the object. See RFC 0041.

Synonym.description: An alternative name for a named object, helping catalogs, AI/LLM tools, and natural language interfaces resolve business vocabulary to the underlying object. See RFC 0041.

id.description: A unique identifier for the synonym, useful when referencing or deduplicating synonyms across tools. Recommended for elements that will be referenced.

description.description: Short human-readable note about when or why this synonym is used.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag (e.g., `en-US`, `fr-FR`) when the synonym is language-specific.

AuthoritativeDefinition.description: A type/link pair for authoritative definitions.

id.description: A unique identifier for the element used to create stable, refactor-safe references. Recommended for elements that will be referenced.

deprecated.description: Indicates this input port is deprecated and should not be used in new implementations. Defaults to false.

id.description: A unique identifier for the element used to create stable, refactor-safe references. Recommended for elements that will be referenced.

contractId.description: Contract ID for the input port.

deprecated.description: Indicates this output port is deprecated and should not be used in new implementations. Defaults to false.

id.description: A unique identifier for the element used to create stable, refactor-safe references. Recommended for elements that will be referenced.

description.description: Human readable short description of the output port.

type.description: There can be different types of output ports, each automated and handled differently. Here you can indicate the type.

version.description: For each version, a different instance of the output port is listed. The combination of the name and version is the key.

contractId.description: Contract ID for the output port.

sbom.description: The SBOM can/should be at the version level.

id.description: A unique identifier for the element used to create stable, refactor-safe references. Recommended for elements that will be referenced.

ManagementPort.description: Management port for managing the data product.

deprecated.description: Indicates this management port is deprecated and should not be used in new implementations. Defaults to false.

id.description: A unique identifier for the element used to create stable, refactor-safe references. Recommended for elements that will be referenced.

type.description: Type: can be `rest` or `topic`. Default is `rest`.

channel.description: Channel to communicate with the data product.

id.description: A unique identifier for the element used to create stable, refactor-safe references. Recommended for elements that will be referenced.

url.description: Access URL using normal URL scheme (https, mailto, etc.).

description.description: Description of the channel, free text.

invitationUrl.description: Some tools uses invitation URL for requesting or subscribing. Follows the URL scheme.

id.description: A unique identifier for the element used to create stable, refactor-safe references. Recommended for elements that will be referenced.

role.description: The user's job role; Examples might be owner, data steward. There is no limit on the role.

dateIn.description: The date when the user joined the team.

dateOut.description: The date when the user ceased to be part of the team.

replacedByUsername.description: The username of the user who replaced the previous user.

Context.description: AI and semantic context block (RFC-0038). Provides structured guidance for AI agents, LLMs, BI tools, and semantic layer platforms. Optional and additive. Applicable at the data product (top level) and output port levels. Input ports refer to the linked ODCS contract's context instead.

instructions.description: Natural language guidance for AI agents and tools on how to use this entity. Equivalent to a system prompt scoped to this level.

verifiedStatements.description: Canonical business questions, each with an optional curated answer. Entries with `answer` should be returned verbatim by AI agents when a query is semantically close; entries without `answer` serve as sample questions for text-to-SQL priming and disambiguation.

id.description: Stable identifier for the entry, useful when referencing or deduplicating verified statements across tools.

answer.description: The expected response or result description. Optional — omit to signal an unanswered sample question.

constraints.description: Negative guidance: what AI agents must NOT do with this entity.

constraint.description: The constraint text (negative guidance for AI agents).
